mission: Build a fast, auditable Swiss legal-research product: verified OpenCaseLaw retrieval -> early query-specific map -> genuinely generative sourced answer -> independent counter-authority search -> incremental visual audit, while minimizing repository-owner attention.

corpus.question: PAUSE — LEGACY CORPUS COMPLETE AND PRESERVED. The 174k corpus, section extraction, BGE/bger crosswalk and historical artifacts remain valid research evidence/fallback data, but are no longer on the MVP critical path. The canonical Swiss source for the new query-specific product is OpenCaseLaw public infrastructure. Re-open corpus only if the MVP exposes a concrete missing data capability that OpenCaseLaw cannot supply.

legal-distance.question: PAUSE — UNIVERSAL 174k LEGAL-GEOMETRY RESEARCH IS NO LONGER THE PRODUCT CRITICAL PATH. Preserve all accepted and negative results. Do not resume dense 174k embedding/citation-heritage work for the MVP. Re-open only if query-specific retrieval/map tests show a specific representation deficiency that cannot be solved with free lexical/citation/open-source methods.

fractal-map.question: PAUSE — GLOBAL 174k FRACTAL MAP AND BLOCKER_PRODUCT_JOIN_ALIGNMENT_V1 ARE SUPERSEDED AS MVP BLOCKERS. Preserve existing clustering/rendering code and artifacts for reuse, but do NOT spend cycles repairing the universal id→cluster join unless the query-specific product later requires it. Product may selectively reuse projection/clustering/WebGL/LOD components.

evaluation.question: EVALUATION v45 — Build a lightweight query-map evaluation harness on the slim lab/evaluation branch. New MVP work should live under evaluation/query_map and tests/evaluation where practical; do NOT restore archived 174k matrices/corpora/results. Reuse existing benchmark code/methodology but keep fixtures small and deterministic. Validate the actual v45 contracts: OpenCaseLaw pagination/provenance/source validity; known relevant-authority recall; contrary/limiting-authority recall; FR/DE/IT robustness; duplicate suppression; generated-answer citation IDs constrained to retrieved decisions; unsupported counter-status downgrade; cache reproducibility; map cluster/projection determinism; progressive latency timing. Compare retrieval/counter machinery against plain OpenCaseLaw ranked search where feasible. Feed concrete failing fixtures directly to Product. Automated tests do not claim UX usefulness. Keep direction_version=45 and continue_recommended=true until Product reaches human_gate_ready.

product.question: PRODUCT v45 — Continue from the accepted lightweight lab/product query-map code, but correct the provisional v44 shortcuts before claiming MVP readiness. Use the VERIFIED OpenCaseLaw REST contract at https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch: GET /api/decisions for paginated search (q/query, limit, offset, language/court filters), GET /api/decisions/{decision_id} for full decision, GET /api/structure/{decision_id} for structured sections, GET /api/citations/{decision_id} for graph expansion, and /api/leading-cases when useful. Do NOT use guessed opencaselaw.org/api/search endpoints. Do NOT merge fixture decisions into normal live results; fixtures are offline/test fallback only and must remain explicitly marked. Preserve the central query_result_bundle. Hot path is progressive: retrieve/dedupe -> return/render initial ranked map -> lazily fetch richer evidence for a small answer pack -> generate/stream a GENUINELY GENERATIVE sourced answer through a provider abstraction (free OpenCode/local model for development; extractive mode only as clearly-labelled degraded fallback) -> run an INDEPENDENT counter-authority pass -> patch statuses/relations into the existing map. The initial map MUST NOT wait for LLM/counter pass. Broad map pool ~100–300, LLM evidence pack smaller. Reuse existing server/UI/TF-IDF/clustering/WebGL/Canvas code; no 174k global artifact loading on startup. Engineering budgets: server startup <3s excluding local-model cold start; cached map <1s; ordinary live first map target <5s subject to source latency; local 100–300 geometry <2s; cached detail <150ms. Consume accepted Frontier v2 artifacts immediately but never wait for them. Required state: direction_version=45, continue_recommended=true until human_gate_ready=true. Acceptance for human gate: one-command local launch, real verified OpenCaseLaw query, clickable clusters/outliers/source links, real generative answer with only validated source IDs, independent contrary/limiting search visibly updating map, offline deterministic fixtures/tests, measured latency/provenance, and no dependency on legacy corpus-scale matrices.

director_note: HUMAN/AUDIT RESET 2026-10-11 direction v45: repository audit found three operational pathologies and fixed them: OpenCode /tmp sandbox mismatch caused successful zero-delta Frontier cycles; active Product/Evaluation branches carried ~4.6 GB of obsolete artifacts; provisional Product v44 used guessed OpenCaseLaw endpoints and an extractive answer. Main is now lightweight, lab/product ~1.6 MB, lab/evaluation ~3.1 MB, Frontier teams reissued as clean human-authorized v2 branches, zero-delta cycles are machine-rejected, and agent mounts/checkouts are shallow/minimal. v45 must build on verified OpenCaseLaw API contracts and a genuinely generative provider path. Old global artifacts remain archived and must not return to active branches.
